cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 rejects an unpacked array argument or assignment pattern item with a narrower element type through "EXTEND unexpected in assignment to unpacked array" (EXTENDS for a signed element), a diagnostic about its own width extension rather than the element types, so the run cannot count it as a language rejection. The designs are invalid (IEEE 1800-2023 7.6, 10.8).
